fullTextZH: 今天我们来看一张照片。
fullTextEN: Today we are going to look at a photo.
There are three people in this photo.
One person, two people, three people.
The sky was also very blue.

fullTextZH: 可是我们的脸是蓝色的。
为什么我们的脸上有蓝色的东西呢？
fullTextEN: Why do our faces have blue stuff on them?

fullTextZH: 其实这个蓝色是防晒霜。
防晒霜就是太阳很大很大的时候，
fullTextEN: Sunscreen is for when the sun is very strong,
We apply it on our faces.
Because if the sun is very strong,
Our faces will become very red.

fullTextZH: 所以那天我们脸上的蓝色是防晒霜。
fullTextEN: So that day the blue on our faces was sunscreen.

fullTextZH: 我们那天三个人一起去做什么了呢？
fullTextEN: What did the three of us do together that day?

fullTextZH: 其实那天我们一起去学冲浪。
fullTextEN: Actually, that day we went to learn surfing together.
I am a pro, I can surf.
Now it's just Zhi Fei and me.

fullTextZH: 在沙滩上学习怎么冲浪。
fullTextEN: Learning how to surf on the beach.

fullTextZH: 他在沙滩上学习冲浪的时候，
fullTextEN: When he was learning to surf on the beach,
Surfing is no problem for me.

fullTextZH: 为什么？因为我游泳游得很好。
fullTextEN: Why? Because I swim very well.
If the waves are too big,

fullTextZH: 我这个比基尼会不会掉啊？

fullTextEN: Shouldn't we wear a bit more?
We finally went into the sea.

fullTextZH: 我们听一听智菲冲浪冲得怎么样吧。
fullTextEN: Let's listen to how well Zhifei surfs.

fullTextZH: 我不明白我的老师说什么。
fullTextEN: I don't understand what my teacher says.
I don't want to surf anymore.
I want to sit by the sea.

fullTextZH: 我们也没有办法知道了。
fullTextEN: We also have no way to know.

fullTextZH: 因为智菲应该不会再冲浪了。
fullTextEN: Because Zhi Fei probably won't surf again.
Waves, please be a bit bigger!
Let me surf a bit more!
I want to fly on the sea!

fullTextZH: 这就是我们今天的故事。
fullTextEN: This is our story for today.
